observation_time.text: Observation time, in hours, minutes and seconds (UTC). The observation time is the midpoint of the 30-s averaging interval used for the record's meteorological data.

flight_level_wind.text: Wind speed, in kt (30-s average). 999 indicates missing value.

sfmr_wind.text: Maximum 10-second average surface wind speed occurring within the encoding interval from the Stepped Frequency Microwave Radiometer (SFMR), in kt. 999 indicates missing value.

sfmr_rain.text: SFMR-derived rain rate, in mm hr-1, evaluated over the 10-s interval chosen for KKK . 999 indicates missing value.

first_column.text: First column indicates status of positional variables as follows:

pos_2.text: 2 Geopotential altitude or static pressure questionable

second_column.text: Second column indicates status of meteorological variables as follows:

met_9.text: 9 T/TD, FL winds, and SFMR questionable
